para.verbatim:
embed:rst Retrieves a unique id for a file within a single ``.ini`` file :raw-html:`
` :raw-html:`
` .. note:: The value is **not** byte-identical to the pure-Python original's, which hashed a `Python`_ tuple through ``CyHashTools.hashLibSerialize``. It is an opaque within-one-run dictionary key -- never written to a file, never persisted, never compared against a previously stored value (the hash that *does* reach a filename is the separate ``graphId`` one, which hashes a plain string and is unchanged) -- so a different canonical serialization is safe here, and avoids two disagreeing implementations of the same id inside one run

parameterdescription.para: The mod object holding the graph for the resource
The name of the section_
The id of the part where the file belongs to
The specific order index where the file occurs in the part
The path for the file

simplesect.para: The unique id for the file
